verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents ongoing monitoring that users can switch on per customer. Its agentic workflows include Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases, and WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks plus async/batch screening support unattended pipelines. However, the Starter plan requires a team to assign cases to an agent first and agent configuration cannot be customized, so user-defined autonomous automation is limited. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/rule builder or scheduling, in-depth docs on how agent automations are set up and triggered, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
